correctness.rationale: The local inverse of the consistent P1 mass is (2/ℓ_i) times the 2-by-2 matrix with diagonal 2 and off-diagonal −1; its true multiplicity averaging inserts 1/k independently on each hub row and column. With S=Σℓ_i, T=Σ1/ℓ_i, h=(ℓ_i), a=(1/ℓ_i), this gives the displayed assembled matrices. Substitution into BM fixes (0,a) and (1,−2e+(2S/k)a); off the equal-length case the joint kernel of eᵀ,hᵀ on leaf coordinates has dimension k−2 and eigenvalue 4/3. The trace gives the last root μ=4ST/(3k²); equal lengths give the same characteristic polynomial by continuity and μ=4/3. Both mass and BRAS matrices are positive definite by assembly with full-column-rank injection. Hence BM is similar to the symmetric-preconditioned matrix, and μ≥4/3 by Cauchy–Schwarz gives the condition number, not a singular-value claim on BM. The Jacobi scaling is identity plus the rank-two off-diagonal unit-vector update with eigenvalues ±1/2. The inequalities ℓ_i+mM/ℓ_i≤m+M and AM–GM give μ≤(R+1)²/(3R), attained by two arms at each endpoint for k=4. Solving against the Jacobi value 3 gives the stated sharp all-star threshold and strict comparison on either side in the claimed senses. Positive lengths, free hub and leaves, and k≥3 are all respected. Checker inspected, not run.
